work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Core contributor across all four Turbot open-source products (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — 120+ merged pull requests and 4,200+ commits across 79 repositories, with 9,300+ combined GitHub stars.
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent to resolve cross-team queries by ingesting the documentation and code graph for all internal repos into S3 vector storage; deployed it to AWS Lambda and integrated it with the Slack Bot API as the UI for easy developer access, resolving onboarding and cross-team queries instantly.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing, cutting resource-discovery latency 70-90%.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes to DuckDB; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements, multi-stage CTEs, and condition-aware filters — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings across 10,000+ resources.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent (Model Context Protocol)
projects.description: Agentic chatbot/agent framework built with Pydantic AI featuring configurable external MCP servers via a persistent MongoDB-backed registry, JSON config loader with strict input validation, per-server failure isolation, native tool calling, mid-conversation multi-model switching (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Mistral), conversation-history persistence, sync + streaming output, prompt-injection safeguards, and Logfire observability.
